what_changed: PR #6 ships two changes against the source-collector reliability investigation (CCE-9). First, `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py` gains opt-in diagnostic capture: when `DOCS_AGENT_DEBUG_DIR` is set, `dispatch_subagent` switches to `--output-format stream-json --verbose` and writes per-subagent artifacts (prompt, extracted stdout, raw NDJSON stream, stderr, and a meta.json with a tool-use summary) to that directory. Behavior is byte-identical to v0.1.3 when the variable is unset. Two new unit tests cover the capture path (suite: 163/163). Second, `agents/source-collector.md` gains an explicit Step 0: when `last_sha` is empty, the agent must emit `{"prs": [], "jira_issues": []}` and stop — this is now the only valid skip path for Steps 1–5. The PR also adds Phase 1 and H4 measurement artifacts (raw stdout captures, state.json snapshots from three Mode B runs, and a validation summary) under `docs/superpowers/measurements/`, plus an investigation plan at `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-20-cce9-source-collector-reliability.md`. The source-collector reliability fix is partial: the agent now cites empty `last_sha` and early-exits per Step 0, but still emits a non-canonical `{"status": "idle", ...}` shape. Two new root causes (stop-verify hook stdout contamination and the agent's status-report reflex) are tracked in CCE-10.
why: The source-collector was emitting off-contract `{"status": "idle", ...}` responses instead of the canonical `{"prs": [], "jira_issues": []}` shape on empty-window runs, breaking downstream schema validation and the full orchestrator pipeline. CCE-9 was opened to investigate systematically. The PR ships the diagnostic infrastructure (`DOCS_AGENT_DEBUG_DIR`) that proved itself during the investigation and an honest partial fix (Step 0 guidance), while explicitly deferring the two newly-identified root causes — stop-verify hook contamination and the agent's status-report reflex — to CCE-10.
notes: Fix is explicitly partial. Step 0 fires correctly on empty `last_sha` but the agent still overrides the canonical-shape instruction with a status-report response. CCE-10 will address hook suppression (`CLAUDE_STOP_VERIFY=0` is already present in orchestrator_runner.py as of this PR) and stronger canonical-shape forcing. The `DOCS_AGENT_DEBUG_DIR` capture mechanism (stream-json mode + tool-use summary) will serve as the measurement vehicle for CCE-10 validation.
